title: seed:full and dev login (emulator only)
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: scripts/seed.ts --mode full per fypms-test-data/references/fixtures-contract.md: Auth users (uid stu-<index> / staff-<localpart>, emailVerified, claims from fx.claimsFor), users docs via the same internal function complete-signup uses, roster/whitelist linkage, supervisor_contacts from staff-profiles.json. Seed teams only if createTeamInTx exists (04-01) and supervisions only if models/supervision exists (06-02); otherwise skip and print what was skipped

Dev login: src/app/dev/login/page.tsx lists the fixture users grouped by role (name, email, role); clicking one calls src/app/api/dev/token/route.ts, which returns an Admin SDK createCustomToken(uid, claims), and the client signs in with signInWithCustomToken so the existing AuthContext sets the __session cookie
Both the page and the route return notFound()/404 unless NODE_ENV is not production AND FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST is set; add /dev/login to the public paths of the route gate only in that condition
rules: Dev login must be impossible in production builds and without the emulator variables
acceptance: After npm run emu:reset && npm run seed:full && npm run check:data, signing in as any fixture user through /dev/login lands on the correct dashboard with the right nav
A production build returns 404 for /dev/login and /api/dev/token
